title: GEMglScaled
description: multiply the current matrix by a general scaling matrix

messages.description: scale factor along the x axis
scale factor along the y axis
scale factor along the z axis

arguments.description: scale factor along the x axis
scale factor along the y axis
scale factor along the z axis

body: [GEMglScaled] calls glScaled() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glScale in the OpenGL reference.
